samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit input operand A.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit input operand B.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">32-bit output representing the result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">1-bit output indicating whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">1-bit output indicating whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">1-bit output indicating whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">1-bit output indicating whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">1-bit output representing a general flag, which is set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter name="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter name="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter name="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter name="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter name="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter name="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter name="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter name="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter name="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter name="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter name="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter name="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter name="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter name="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter name="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter name="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="res" width_description="[63:0]" type="wire">64-bit result for operations.</signal>
        <signal id="shift_amount" width_description="[4:0]" type="wire">Shift amount for shift operations.</signal>
        <assign>shift_amount = aluc == SLL || aluc == SRL || aluc == SRA ? a[4:0] : a;</assign>
        <always @(*)>
            case (aluc)
                ADD: res = $signed(a) + $signed(b);
                ADDU: res = unsigned(a) + unsigned(b);
                SUB: res = $signed(a) - $signed(b);
                SUBU: res = unsigned(a) - unsigned(b);
                AND: res = a & b;
                OR: res = a | b;
                XOR: res = a ^ b;
                NOR: res = ~(a | b);
                SLT: res = $signed(a) < $signed(b) ? 1 : 0;
                SLTU: res = unsigned(a) < unsigned(b) ? 1 : 0;
                SLL: res = {32'b0, a << shift_amount};
                SRL: res = {32'b0, a >> shift_amount};
                SRA: res = {a[31], a >> shift_amount};
                SLLV: res = {32'b0, a << (b & 31)};
                SRLV: res = {32'b0, a >> (b & 31)};
                SRAV: res = {a[31], a >> (b & 31)};
                LUI: res = {a[15:0], 16'b0};
                default: res = 64'bZ;
            endcase
        </always>
        <assign>r = res[31:0];</assign>
        <assign>zero = res == 32'b0 ? 1 : 0;</assign>
        <assign>carry = aluc == ADD || aluc == SUB ? res[32] : 0;</assign>
        <assign>negative = res[31];</assign>
        <assign>overflow = aluc == ADD || aluc == SUB ? ($signed(a) > 0 && $signed(b) > 0 && $signed(res) <= 0) || ($signed(a) < 0 && $signed(b) < 0 && $signed(res) >= 0) : 0;</assign>
        <assign>flag = aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU ? res[0] : 0;</assign>
    </logic_description>
</module>
